lines.name: Najdorf vs. 6.Be3
lines.intro: The Najdorf is the sharpest Sicilian. You trade your c-pawn for White's d-pawn, then play ...a6 to control b5. Against 6.Be3, grab space with ...e5 and develop quickly.

notes.0: White opens with the king's pawn.
notes.1: The Sicilian: fight for d4 from the side and steer into an unbalanced game.
notes.3: Control e5, so your knight on f6 can't be kicked by e5 later.
notes.5: Trade your c-pawn for White's center pawn. You get the half-open c-file.
notes.6: White takes back with the knight.
notes.7: Develop with an attack on e4.
notes.9: The Najdorf move: control b5 and keep your options open.
notes.10: The English Attack setup: Be3, f3, Qd2, and castling long.
notes.11: Kick the knight and grab space in the center.
notes.13: Develop and control d5, the key square in this structure.
notes.14: White stops ...Ng4 from hitting the e3 bishop.
notes.15: Get ready to castle. Then come ...Nbd7 and ...b5.

lines.name: Najdorf vs. 6.Be2
lines.intro: Against the quiet 6.Be2, take space with ...e5, develop, and castle. Your play comes on the queenside and against e4.

notes.0: White opens with the king's pawn.
notes.1: The Sicilian: fight for d4 from the side and steer into an unbalanced game.
notes.3: Control e5, so your knight on f6 can't be kicked by e5 later.
notes.5: Trade your c-pawn for White's center pawn. You get the half-open c-file.
notes.6: White takes back with the knight.
notes.7: Develop with an attack on e4.
notes.9: The Najdorf move: control b5 and keep your options open.
notes.10: A quiet setup. White plans to castle short.
notes.11: Kick the knight and grab space in the center.
notes.13: Develop and get ready to castle.

lines.name: Alapin (2.c3)
lines.intro: In the Alapin, White plays c3 to build a big center with d4. Hit e4 right away with ...Nf6, then trade on d4 and develop.

notes.0: White opens with the king's pawn.
notes.1: The Sicilian: fight for d4 from the side and steer into an unbalanced game.
notes.2: The Alapin: White prepares d4 so it can take back with a pawn.
notes.5: The knight lands on a strong central square.
notes.8: White develops and gets ready to take back on d4.
notes.9: Develop and add pressure on d4 and e5.
notes.11: Challenge e5 right away and open the c8 bishop.
